ops.body:
Executed 2026-07-15 as a live prototype (apple/container 1.1.0 + socktainer 1.1.1 installed with user approval). All 5 experiments run + recorded; verdict note 4656afb supersedes the spike memo 452679f; full chronology + proxy-fix diff in cc-notes log `apple-container-prototype`.

Outcome: **NO-GO for immediate production; the one confirmed FAIL is lifecycle/recovery (#158/#286 no auto-restart).** Sandbox = CONDITIONAL PASS with a proxy fix (found + fixed + verified a CRITICAL socktainer docker.sock-relay host-escape → task da1c63). Egress isolable only via custom non-NAT nets. Memory ~340MB idle/micro-VM (load-growth deferred). Backup: bind-mounts keep restic file-level. Bonus wholesale-NixOS-machine path boot-blocked on read-only rootfs (in-flight fix). Both the E1 finding and the verdict took codex adversarial refuter passes with challenges verified directly.

Follow-ups spun out as their own backlog tasks: da1c63 (proxy destination-screening — REQUIRED prereq), 827913e (gvisor build-break, unrelated), ad1beb (standing upstream watch). Deferred/not-blocking: 24h memory-under-load soak, cold-boot recovery (no-reboot constraint), full tailnet join (user authkey), pf enforcement (root-gated). The migration itself, if pursued, is a new plan gated on the prerequisite list in note 4656afb.
